title: Duplex Printing
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

Takahashi wants to print a document with $N$ pages double-sided, where two pages of data can be printed on one sheet of paper.

At least how many sheets of paper does he need?

## Constraints

- $N$ is an integer.
- $1 \leq N \leq 100$

## Input

Input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
N
```

## Output

Print the answer.

samples.note: By printing the $1$-st, $2$-nd pages on the $1$-st sheet, $3$-rd and $4$-th pages on the $2$-nd sheet, and $5$-th page on the $3$-rd sheet, we can print all the data on $3$ sheets of paper.
